title: Some things have changed
content: I was at the mall again last night. I was with someone I knew in the dream but don't know IRL. I told him how nice it was of him to let me drag him around the place. We came in from outside and I recognized it, but I said the stores had changed. Different stores. I desperately wanted to get to what I feel are doorways that lead out to the bars, in a place near the dining tables of the food court, across from the main entrance. I remember looking back, and seeing an elevated, brightly lit walkway that I've never seen before, but I knew it was part of the hospital. I never made it to the doors last night.
